# Eeshan Gupta

> Personal site of Eeshan Gupta, a Senior AI Engineer in Bengaluru, India, working on production GenAI, RAG and voice AI systems. Writes about RAG evaluation and retrieval experiments.

## Writing

- [Is GraphRAG worth it? A small, pre-registered test against a properly tuned baseline](https://eeshangpt.github.io/writing/graphrag-vs-tuned-hybrid/index.md): a pre-registered experiment comparing a graph retriever with a tuned hybrid retriever at the same context budget on MuSiQue and 2WikiMultiHopQA.
- [All writing](https://eeshangpt.github.io/writing/): index of articles.

## Code

- [graphrag-vs-tuned-hybrid](https://github.com/eeshangpt/graphrag-vs-tuned-hybrid): code, data and pre-registration history for the experiment.
